description: This file is a shell script containing a series of unit tests for a JSON writing utility called 'json-writer'. The tests include examples of generating JSON objects and arrays, handling nested structures, escaping strings, and validating JSON output through parsing with Perl scripts. It serves as a test suite for verifying JSON serialization functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output against expected output files.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs the JSON writing tool or related commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
